concepts.name: Edition T
concepts.idea: A sequence of editions, collected into one initial.
short: A repeated band, an offset, one initial.
The closest evolution of the current mark.
concepts.risk: The stepped bars can still read as a technical or signal symbol.

concepts.name: Ribbon T
concepts.idea: A color band turns into a flowing, asymmetric T.
short: A color band bends into a signature.
More movement; a softer collectible voice.
concepts.risk: The curved stem can suggest an umbrella or a J before a T.

concepts.name: Contour T
concepts.idea: A T inside a T: a permanent identity surrounded by its edition.
short: An outer T holds a second T in the counter.
The artwork’s contour language, made compact.
concepts.risk: The internal channel needs optical adjustment below 24 px.

concepts.name: Four fields
concepts.idea: Four independent fields leave a shared T-shaped space.
short: Four fields around a shared negative-space T.
A nod to identity without using literal numbers.
concepts.risk: The symbol is more abstract; the upper split can make it read as a cross.

concepts.name: Edition seal
concepts.idea: A compact portrait edition with an inset T, like a publisher’s seal.
short: A portrait frame becomes a publisher’s seal.
An art-edition reading, with a compact footprint.
concepts.risk: The surrounding frame is generic; it may compete with the NFT frame.

concepts.name: Drawn signature
concepts.idea: A bespoke lowercase signature with repeated t geometry and a square i dot.
short: A drawn lowercase wordmark with shared t forms.
Let the lettering carry the entire identity.
concepts.risk: The wordmark cannot serve as a favicon; its t is only a provisional companion.
